name: Pole Training
description:
You are trained in the use of all grades of the Acrobat's Pole, a special weapon type.

Whenever you make an attack with an Acrobat's Pole, you may either make one attack against one creature or two attacks against two different creatures.

Describe your technique.

improvements.name: Vault
improvements.description:
Once per turn, you may use your Acrobat's Pole to enhance your movement. Choose one:

  • Your jump distance is doubled for your next jump this turn.

  • The height of vertical surface you can run up is doubled this turn.

In either case, the increase does not cost you additional movement.

improvements.name: Spin Attack
improvements.description: When you attack with an Acrobat's Pole, you may spend 1 additional action to attack all creatures within reach simultaneously with a single attack roll, skipping Engagement.

improvements.name: Ground Spin
improvements.description: When you make a Spin Attack, you may spend an additional action to roll Dexterity vs Dexterity against each creature you hit. On each win, the creature is knocked prone.
